act.label: Nizam (Royal Decree Law)

hierarchy.note: Used only in the largest codes (Civil Transactions Law). Rare.
Higher division above the article, NOT the basic unit. Civil law usage of 'section'.

act.note: Enacted by Royal Decree (RD No. number/year). Article numbering is continuous throughout the entire law.

basic_law.label: Al-Nizam al-Asasi (Basic Law of the State)
basic_law.note: The Basic Law functions as Oman's constitution. Enacted by Royal Decree. Current: RD 6/2021. Previous: RD 101/1996.

implementing_regulation.label: La'iha Tanfidhiyya (Implementing Regulation / Ministerial Decision)
implementing_regulation.note: Issued by ministerial decision to implement a parent nizam. Uses 'si' subtype in FRBR URI.

frbr.date_calendar_note: Oman uses Gregorian calendar as primary dating system for legislation. Royal Decrees are cited as No. {number}/{year} with Gregorian year. Differs from Saudi Arabia which uses Hijri.

numbering.insertion_note: Inserted articles use 'bis' suffix (مكرر): Article 5 bis. eId: art_5bis. Inconsistently applied — many amendments use wholesale replacement by new Royal Decree instead.

enacting_formulae.text: Having reviewed the Basic Law of the State, And in pursuance of the public interest, We hereby decree the following:
enacting_formulae.text_ara: بعد الاطلاع على النظام الأساسي للدولة، وبناءً على ما تقتضيه المصلحة العامة، رسمنا بما هو آت:
enacting_formulae.note: References Basic Law RD 6/2021. Arabic is authoritative.

enacting_formulae.text: Having reviewed the Basic Law of the Sultanate issued by Royal Decree No. 101/96, And in pursuance of the public interest, We hereby decree the following:
enacting_formulae.text_ara: بعد الاطلاع على النظام الأساسي للدولة الصادر بالمرسوم السلطاني رقم ١٠١/٩٦، وبناءً على ما تقتضيه المصلحة العامة، رسمنا بما هو آت:
enacting_formulae.note: References Basic Law RD 101/1996. Used between 1996 and 2021.

amendments.phrasing: يُستبدل بنص المادة ({N}) ... النص الآتي / Article ({N}) of [Law] shall be replaced by the following:
amendments.note: Major revisions use wholesale replacement (new RD supersedes old). Targeted amendments substitute specific articles. Both patterns must be handled.

structuring.prompt_additions: Oman uses ARTICLE as the basic unit (Maddah / مادة). CHAPTER (Bab / باب) and SECTION (Fasl / فصل) are higher divisions above the article, not the basic unit. PART (Juz' / جزء) and BOOK (Kitab / كتاب) appear in large codes. Paragraphs within articles use PARAGRAPH (Faqrah / فقرة). Items use POINT (Band / بند). Arabic is RTL; article numbering is continuous throughout the entire law, never restarting per chapter. The enacting formula appears in the preamble as the Sultan's decree.

supranational_memberships.note: GCC Unified Laws require domestic transposition by Royal Decree. GCC instruments are not directly effective in Oman.

validation.note: Public reference profile; synthetic XML controls do not certify corpus coverage.
